LPM.Title: Lockpick Minigames
LPM.Hint.sweetspot: Move the pick to find the sweet spot, then hold the mouse button to turn the lock.
LPM.Hint.dual: Hold SPACE (or the mouse button) and keep the cursor on the drifting glow.
LPM.Hint.tumbler: Click each pin at the top of its bounce to set it in place.
LPM.Hint.skillcheck: Click or press SPACE when the needle crosses the highlighted zone. The blue centre counts double.
LPM.Hint.tension: Click the dial to start. Hold SPACE to build tension and keep it inside the green band.
LPM.Hint.tensionGo: Keep the tension in the green band and click the glowing target.
LPM.Hint.trace: Click the S marker to start, then guide the cursor along the keyway to E without touching the walls.
LPM.Hint.traceGo: Steady… follow the keyway to the E marker.
LPM.Hint.traceHit: You scraped the ward. Click S to start again.
LPM.Tension.Label: Tension
LPM.Config.EnabledHint: Whether players can attempt this lock with a minigame.
LPM.Config.TierHint: The character's skill and tools lower the tier they actually play.
LPM.Config.KeyPlaceholder: Item name, or several separated by commas
LPM.Config.KeyHint: A character carrying an item with this exact name opens the lock without a minigame.
LPM.Config.MaxAttemptsHint: -1 uses the world setting, 0 is unlimited.
LPM.Config.CooldownHint: -1 uses the world setting, 0 is none.
LPM.Config.MacroHint: Macro names. The macro receives actor, token, lockDocument, user, success, via and jammed.
LPM.Notify.NoGM: No GM is connected, so the lock cannot be picked right now.
LPM.Notify.Jammed: This lock is jammed. Nothing short of a key or the GM will open it.
LPM.Notify.Cooldown: You need a moment before trying again ({s}s).
LPM.Notify.NoAttempts: You have used all your attempts on this lock.
LPM.Notify.NoActor: You need a character to pick locks.
LPM.Notify.NoToken: Select or own a token on this scene first.
LPM.Notify.TooFar: Too far from the lock ({d} {units}, max {max}).
LPM.Notify.NeedTool: You need lock-picking tools to attempt this.
LPM.Notify.NowJammed: The lock jams! It will not take another pick.
LPM.Notify.NothingNear: No locked door or container within reach.
LPM.Chat.Jammed: {actor} failed to pick {lock} ({game}, {tier}) and jammed it. Attempt {n}.
LPM.Key.PickNearest.Name: Pick the nearest lock
LPM.Key.PickNearest.Hint: Starts a lock-picking attempt on the nearest locked door or container within reach of your token.
LPM.Setting.demo.Name: Playground
LPM.Setting.demo.Label: Open the playground
LPM.Setting.demo.Hint: Try every minigame at any difficulty without a lock.
LPM.Setting.doorsDefault.Name: Locked doors are pickable
LPM.Setting.doorsDefault.Hint: Every locked door can be picked with the world defaults unless its own lock settings say otherwise. Tokens must always be configured.
LPM.Setting.defaultGame.Name: Default minigame
LPM.Setting.defaultGame.Hint: Used by locks that do not choose their own.
LPM.Setting.defaultTier.Name: Default difficulty
LPM.Setting.defaultTier.Hint: Used by locks that do not set their own tier.
LPM.Setting.interactionDistance.Name: Interaction distance
LPM.Setting.interactionDistance.Hint: Maximum distance in scene units from the player's token to the lock. 0 disables the check.
LPM.Setting.maxAttempts.Name: Default max attempts per player
LPM.Setting.maxAttempts.Hint: 0 is unlimited. Locks can override this.
LPM.Setting.jam.Name: Jam the lock when attempts run out
LPM.Setting.jam.Hint: A jammed lock refuses further picking until the GM resets it or a key is used.
LPM.Setting.cooldown.Name: Default cooldown after failure (seconds)
LPM.Setting.cooldown.Hint: 0 is none. Locks can override this.
LPM.Setting.skillPath.Name: Skill attribute path
LPM.Setting.skillPath.Hint: Actor data path of the number that lowers the difficulty, e.g. system.skills.slt.total (dnd5e Sleight of Hand) or system.abilities.dex.mod. Leave empty for none.
LPM.Setting.skillDivisor.Name: Skill divisor
LPM.Setting.skillDivisor.Hint: The tier drops by floor(skill value / divisor).
LPM.Setting.tools.Name: Lock-picking tools
LPM.Setting.tools.Hint: Item names with their tier reduction, separated by semicolons: Thieves' Tools=2; Masterwork Picks=4. The best tool carried counts.
LPM.Setting.requireTool.Name: Tools required
LPM.Setting.requireTool.Hint: Players without one of the tools above cannot attempt a lock.
LPM.Setting.toolBreakChance.Name: Tool break chance on failure (%)
LPM.Setting.toolBreakChance.Hint: Chance that one of the tool items is consumed when an attempt fails.
LPM.Setting.openOnSuccess.Name: Open doors on success
LPM.Setting.openOnSuccess.Hint: Off: a picked door becomes unlocked and the player opens it with a second click.
LPM.Setting.chat.Name: Chat messages
LPM.Setting.chat.Hint: Whisper the outcome of every attempt to the GM and the player.
